newsitem.title: USA: Texaco US downstream venture on track - CEO.
newsitem.headline: Texaco US downstream venture on track - CEO.

text.p: Texaco Inc Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Peter Bijur said talks on forming a U.S. domestic downstream joint venture with Shell Oil Co, the U.S. unit of Royal Dutch/Shell, are on track and announcement of a deal is still expected in the first quarter.
"It's a very good deal and we hope to have something to announce shortly," he told reporters after a speech at Cambridge Energy Research Associates energy forum in Houston.

Bijur said there have been no discussions about closing domestic refineries operated by the two companies and talks have not ventured beyond inclusion of U.S. downstream operations in the business combination.
"It does not include any upstream operations at all," he said.
